requirements.requirement: The system must define a comparison schema that includes a unique provider identifier for each provider.
The system must include provider display attributes in the schema (name, specialty, location) for each provider.
The system must include an overall evaluation score field for each provider in the comparison schema.
The system must include a list of individual evaluation measures per provider, each with a name, value, and score.
The system must define a normalized structure for measures so that the same measure keys are present across all compared providers.
The system must include a relative ranking indicator per measure for each provider (e.g., higher, lower, equal).
The system must support comparison of two or more providers within a single schema payload.
The system must define the schema in a way that is directly mappable from the backend EVAL-COMPARE API response without requiring structural transformation beyond field mapping.
The system must include explicit ordering metadata for providers to support consistent side-by-side rendering.
The system must include a flag or field indicating missing or unavailable measure data for a provider.
The system must handle the case where a provider lacks one or more measures by representing those measures as null or explicitly marked missing without breaking the schema.
The system must handle the case where fewer than two providers are returned by the backend by returning a valid schema with an error or warning indicator.
The system must include a schema version identifier to support backward compatibility and future evolution.
The system must ensure all numeric score fields are typed consistently (e.g., number) across providers and measures.
The system must define a UI contract that guarantees deterministic rendering given the same schema input.
